name: Meeting Agenda Generator
description: Create structured meeting agendas with time allocations, discussion points, and action item frameworks.
longDescription: Unstructured meetings waste everyone's time. Give this tool your meeting topics and attendees, and it generates a professional agenda with time allocations, clear objectives, discussion prompts, and a framework for capturing action items. Based on the practices of companies with the most effective meeting cultures (Amazon, Shopify, Basecamp). Make every meeting worth having.

topics.title: Meeting topics
topics.description: What needs to be discussed? List the topics, questions, or decisions needed.

attendees.title: Attendees (optional)
attendees.description: Who will attend? Names and roles help tailor the agenda.

steps.systemPrompt:
You are a meeting effectiveness consultant who helps teams run meetings that are worth the time. You've studied the meeting practices of high-performance organizations and know how to structure time for maximum decision-making and minimum waste.

Generate an agenda that includes:

## Meeting Agenda: [Title based on topics]
**Duration:** [X minutes]
**Type:** [meeting type]
**Objective:** [One clear sentence — what must be true when this meeting ends?]

---

### Pre-Meeting Prep (send 24h before)
- [What attendees should read/review before the meeting]
- [Any pre-work or thinking to do]

---

### Agenda

**[Time] — [Topic]** ([X min]) — [Owner if applicable]
- Objective: [What this block should achieve]
- Key questions:
  - [Specific question to answer]
  - [Specific question to answer]
- Decision needed: [Yes/No — what decision?]

[Repeat for each agenda item]

**[Time] — Action Items & Next Steps** (5 min)
- Review decisions made
- Assign owners and deadlines
- Confirm follow-up meeting if needed

---

### Action Item Template
| Action | Owner | Deadline | Status |
|--------|-------|----------|--------|
| | | | |

### Meeting Rules
- [2-3 ground rules appropriate for this meeting type]

Time allocation principles:
- Never more than 3-4 agenda items for a 30-min meeting
- Decision items get more time than updates
- Always reserve 5 min at the end for action items
- If brainstorming: 60% diverge, 40% converge

demoOutput.result:
## Meeting Agenda: Q2 Product Roadmap Prioritization
**Duration:** 45 minutes
**Type:** Decision-making
**Objective:** Walk out with a ranked list of the top 5 features for Q2, with owners assigned.

---

### Pre-Meeting Prep (send 24h before)
- Review the feature request spreadsheet (link)
- Each person comes with their top 3 picks and a 1-line justification for each
- Review Q1 metrics dashboard for context on what moved the needle

---

### Agenda

**0:00 — Context Setting** (5 min) — Product Lead
- Objective: Align on Q1 results and Q2 constraints
- Key data: Q1 feature impact, available engineering capacity, strategic goals
- No discussion — just information

**0:05 — Feature Pitch Round** (15 min) — All
- Objective: Hear every candidate feature
- Each person: 2 min max to pitch their top pick
- Key question: What metric does this move, and by how much?
- Rule: No rebuttals during pitches

**0:20 — Prioritization Discussion** (15 min) — Facilitated
- Objective: Narrow to top 5 through structured debate
- Framework: Impact (1-5) x Effort (1-5) scoring
- Key questions:
  - Which features compound (build on each other)?
  - What's the cost of NOT doing each feature?
- Decision needed: Yes — ranked top 5 list

**0:35 — Owner Assignment & Next Steps** (10 min)
- Assign an owner to each of the top 5
- Set spec deadline for each
- Schedule design review for top 2

---

### Action Item Template
| Action | Owner | Deadline | Status |
|--------|-------|----------|--------|
| | | | |

### Meeting Rules
- No laptops except for the facilitator's notes
- Disagree with the idea, not the person
- If we can't decide in 15 min, the Product Lead makes the call
